description: L1 (Windows 11 dev shell + CDP) before/after for 2026-09-29-preview-audio-ready-wait. Phases: a=first open then play, b_resume=pause->play, b_seek=seek 90s->play, c=after a duration-changing edit (rebuildServices), d_rerender=full re-render (akari.preview.refreshMedia), d_reopen=close tab and reopen, e=app restart and reopen, swap=bgm-a.mp3 replaced by same-size 880 Hz file then re-render, props=mute/rate/ducking/drift. firstSoundMs = play press to first non-silent sample at an AnalyserNode tapped before AudioDestinationNode; videoMovesMs = play press until debug().renderedTimelineSec advances 0.1 s; gateHeldMs = time debug().supply.gate.holding was true; labels = time #audio-status showed each text. fetch/decode counts come from hooks on window.fetch and BaseAudioContext.decodeAudioData installed via CDP before the preview document loads. pcm-window = Range reads of pcm-s16le sidecars (streaming, not whole-file).
fixture: timeline 200 s: main.mp4 (200 s, 1280x720, AAC, 3 cuts -> 3 embedded speech flac sidecars), bgm-a.mp3 (210 s, 5,041,884 B) as 3 trimmed clips at 0/40/160 s, bgm-b.m4a (195 s, 4,763,176 B) as 2 trimmed clips at 100/130 s, 6 narrations (wav/m4a 4-30 s), 3 sfx (wav/mp3/m4a)
environment: Electron 39.8.7 dev build of apps/shell (theia build --mode production); ffmpeg.dll replaced with the installed app's proprietary-codec build so AAC decodes as in the product (Theia's build swaps in a non-proprietary ffmpeg.dll that cannot decode m4a); isolated user-data-dir / THEIA_CONFIG_DIR / AKARI_HOME; frame-engine bundle regenerated locally for the after run only (not committed).
